bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0d11477f61837c3da7da42393daa1bf04b01088e"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json,hashlib,pathlib,urllib.request
paths=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","-z","--","server","orchestrator","bin","mcp","scripts","docs","package.json"]).decode().strip("\0").split("\0")
files={p:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
for name in ("debug-ai-debug-ai-1","debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1"):
 code='const fs=require("node:fs"),c=require("node:crypto");const e=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8"));const bad=Object.keys(e).filter(p=>{try{return c.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync("/app/"+p)).digest("hex")!==e[p]}catch{return true}});console.log(JSON.stringify({files:Object.keys(e).length,mismatches:bad}));if(bad.length)process.exitCode=1'
 p=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","-i",name,"node","-e",code],input=json.dumps(files),text=True,capture_output=True)
 print("PARITY "+name+" "+p.stdout.strip(),flush=True)
 if p.returncode:raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
req=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/investigation-benchmark/start",data=json.dumps({"suite":"real-debug"}).encode(),headers={"content-type":"application/json"},method="POST")
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15) as resp:
 o=json.load(resp)
 assert resp.status==202 and o.get("total")==50 and o.get("state")=="RUNNING"
 print("BENCHMARK_ACCEPTED "+json.dumps(o),flush=True)
 rid=o["benchmark_id"]
 status=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/"+rid,timeout=5))
 print("BENCHMARK_STATUS "+json.dumps({k:status.get(k) for k in ("benchmark_id","state","current","summary","active_in_process","error_code")}),flush=True)
PY
